title: Core Models
requirements: Implement DiaryEntry struct (id: UUID, startedAt: Date, durationSeconds: Double, audioPath: String, transcriptPath: String, source: TranscriptSource, createdAt: Date, updatedAt: Date) as Hashable, Codable, Sendable
Implement Transcript struct (text: String, confidence: Double?, source: TranscriptSource, isFinal: Bool) as Hashable, Codable, Sendable
Implement TranscriptSource enum (speech, whisper, none) as String, Codable, Sendable
Implement TranscriptUpdate enum (partial(String), final(Transcript), failed(String)) as Sendable
acceptance_criteria: DiaryEntry, Transcript, and TranscriptSource compile as Codable and Sendable; TranscriptUpdate compiles as Sendable
DiaryEntry round-trips through JSON encoding/decoding with no data loss
TranscriptSource encodes as lowercase string values
notes: Audit-flip from prior Ralph loops. All four types exist in Sources/DiaryTranscriber/Models/ with the exact field declarations and conformance clauses specified: DiaryEntry (8 fields, Hashable+Codable+Sendable+Identifiable, private CodingKeys for all fields), Transcript (4 fields, Hashable+Codable+Sendable, private CodingKeys), TranscriptSource (String rawValue, lowercase case names speech/whisper/none), TranscriptUpdate (3 cases with payload, Sendable). Existing test coverage in Tests/DiaryTranscriberTests/CoreModelTests.swift already covers every acceptance criterion: testDiaryEntry_roundTripsJSON_noDataLoss, testDiaryEntry_defaultUpdatedAt_equalsCreatedAt, testTranscriptSource_encodesAsLowercaseString + decode-reverse, testTranscript_roundTripsJSON_noDataLoss, testTranscript_confidenceDefaultsToNilWhenAbsent, and three testTranscriptUpdate_* cases.
